title: EU: Lumentum Holdings (LITE) Stock Has Just Had Its Strong Buy Rating Reiterated by Raymond James. Shares now Have a $87 Target
text:
Posted by Linda Rogers 2:57 am Lumentum Holdings (LITE) Rating Reaffirmed
Lumentum Holdings (LITE) just had their share rating of a ‘Strong Buy’ issued by research analysts at Raymond James, who now has a $87 TP on the $2.80B market cap company or a 96.97 % upside potential. This key information was revealed to investors in a research note on 11 December. Lumentum Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ:LITE) Ratings Coverage
Among 7 analysts covering Lumentum Holdings ( LITE ), 6 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 1 Hold. Therefore 86% are positive. Lumentum Holdings has $90 highest and $50 lowest target. $71.57’s average target is 62.03% above currents $44.17 stock price. Lumentum Holdings had 8 analyst reports since June 20, 2018 according to SRatingsIntel. The rating was maintained by Barclays Capital on Thursday, August 9 with “Overweight”. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Tuesday, November 13 by FBR Capital. JP Morgan downgraded Lumentum Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ:LITE) rating on Tuesday, November 13. JP Morgan has “Neutral” rating and $50 target. The company was upgraded on Thursday, October 11 by JP Morgan. The stock of Lumentum Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ:LITE) earned “Buy” rating by Goldman Sachs on Wednesday, June 20. As per Wednesday, September 5, the company rating was maintained by Needham. UBS maintained Lumentum Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ:LITE) on Wednesday, November 14 with “Buy” rating. Raymond James maintained the shares of LITE in report on Wednesday, August 22 with “Strong Buy” rating.
The stock increased 1.77% or $0.77 $44.17. About 3.54M shares traded or 67.79% up from the average. Lumentum Holdings Inc. (LITE) has declined 10.61% downtrending. It has underperformed by 10.61% the S&P500.
Analysts await Lumentum Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ:LITE) to report earnings on February, 5. They expect $1.02 earnings per share, down 29.17 % or $0.42 from last year’s $1.44 per share. LITE’s profit will be $64.66M for 10.83 P/E if the $1.02 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.14 actual earnings per share reported by Lumentum Holdings Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -10.53 % negative EPS growth.
Lumentum Holdings Inc. manufactures and sells optical and photonic products in the Americas, the Asia-Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. $2.80 billion. It operates through two divisions, Optical Communications and Commercial Lasers. It has a 9.85 P/E ratio. The Optical Communications segment offers components, modules, and subsystems that enable the transmission and transport of video, audio, and text data over high-capacity fiber optic cables.
